items.prompt: Please describe how you have learned about and engaged with Tufts during your college search process
items.ru: Первый обязательный короткий ответ: как вы узнавали о Tufts и взаимодействовали с ним. 75–150 слов.
items.evidence: Short Answer Prompt #1: Please describe how you have learned about and engaged with Tufts during your college search process (75-150 words).

items.prompt: Tell us about one of your favorite school assignments in the past two years. What was the assignment and why did you enjoy it?
items.ru: Для School of Arts and Sciences: любимое школьное задание за последние два года и почему оно понравилось. 100–200 слов.
items.evidence: Applicants to the School of Arts and Sciences are required to answer the following question in 100-200 words: Tell us about one of your favorite school assignments in the past two years. What was the assignment and why did you enjoy it?

items.prompt: Tell us about an engineering or science-related project that you have helped build, design, create, or iterate in the past two years. What was the project and what was your role?
items.ru: Для School of Engineering: инженерный или научный проект за последние два года и ваша роль. 100–200 слов.
items.evidence: Applicants to the School of Engineering are required to answer the following question in 100-200 words: Tell us about an engineering or science-related project that you have helped build, design, create, or iterate in the past two years. What was the project and what was your role?

items.prompt: Tell us more about a specific piece in your portfolio. What were the ideas you intended to explore, and how did those ideas inform the process of making the piece?
items.ru: Для BFA: расскажите об одной работе из портфолио, какие идеи вы хотели исследовать. 100–200 слов.
items.evidence: Applicants to the Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) program are required to answer the following question in 100-200 words: Tell us more about a specific piece in your portfolio. What were the ideas you intended to explore, and how did those ideas inform the process of making the piece?

items.prompt: Tell us more about a specific piece in your portfolio. How did an academic course, project, or interest inspire the ideas that you explored in this piece? Or, how did making this piece influence your academic interests?
items.ru: Для Combined Degree (BFA+BA/BS): расскажите о работе из портфолио и её связи с учёбой. 100–200 слов.
items.evidence: Applicants to the Combined Degree (BFA+BA/BS) program are required to answer the following question in 100-200 words: Tell us more about a specific piece in your portfolio. How did an academic course, project, or interest inspire the ideas that you explored in this piece? Or, how did making this piece influence your academic interests?

items.ru: Рекомендация школьного консультанта или другого школьного руководителя.
Рекомендация от учителя основного предмета: английский, математика, естественные науки, история или язык.
items.evidence: Teacher Recommendation from a core academic teacher in English, mathematics, natural or physical science, history or social science, or world language.

items.ru: Портфолио обязательно для BFA и BFA+BA/BS в SMFA at Tufts.
items.evidence: Visual Art Portfolio : Required for applicants to the BFA or BFA+BA/BS Combined Degree programs at SMFA at Tufts.

items.ru: По желанию можно приложить интервью InitialView или Duolingo для подтверждения английского.
items.evidence: Yes, Tufts will accept an interview from InitialView or Duolingo , in addition to English language proficiency results, for the purpose of demonstrating English language skills.

note: Общее эссе и список активностей Common App общие, не внесены. Портфолио обязательно только для BFA и BFA+BA/BS.
